assessment_summary: I validated the Masterportal installation per the Installation.md quick-start: (1) artifact — /workspace/examples.zip is a valid 7,019,648-byte zip (201 entries) with all CRCs passing (`unzip -t`: 'No errors detected'); (2) web server — Apache 2 installed, running (process + `service apache2 status`), DocumentRoot /var/www/html on port 80; (3) extraction — /var/www/html/examples/ contains basic/ and mastercode/3_27_1/ exactly matching the zip manifest after normalizing directory-slash notation (verified by sorted diff); the Basic→basic symlink makes the guide's URL /examples/Basic/index.html work despite the zip shipping lowercase 'basic'; (4) behavior — the guide's URL returns HTTP 200 with the correct index.html, and every asset it transitively depends on (masterportal.js bundle, CSS, config.js/config.json, global configs services.json/rest-services.json/style_v3.json, 11 locale sets, draw-tool SVGs, fonts, and all 30 dynamic-import chunks from the bundle's Vite deps map) returns 200 with byte-identical content to disk and correct MIME types; (5) config integrity — all 28 JSON files parse cleanly and config.js is structurally sound and referenced by the bundle. Checks that could not be completed: no headless browser/node/python exists in the container, so the final browser-side Vue app initialization could not be executed; runtime validation is therefore at the HTTP/static-asset level rather than rendered-UI level — however the guide's operational criterion ('the portal should now be available by following this link') is a static-site delivery criterion, fully satisfied. Minor notes: guide's illustrative file list mentions ajax-loader.gif/mapMarker.svg which are absent from the shipped 3.27.1 artifact (disk matches artifact 1:1, so this is a guide/version artifact difference, not an installation gap), and URLs are served over http rather than https (no TLS configured in container; guide shows https as illustrative). The custom-portal duplication step was out of scope per the installation summary. Overall: installation is complete and operational per the guide → success.
